applies_why: The judge text addresses whether Matthew 1:16 was answered and therefore whether it may be counted as an unanswered witness, which is what K-G4 governs.
quote: the defender answered the beget-pattern and naming witnesses in [CR3] LINK 4 and [CR2] §5, and the challenger answered hēs in [DR3] C2.
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: The judge records that the verse was answered and does not count it as an unanswered witness or as part of a broken link, so it obeys K-G4.
